raw_response:
This small piece of land is for my yam and cassava, mixed together as I have always planted them. I am an old woman with little money, and chemical fertilizer is costly and not always easy to find here — for root crops we mostly rely on the soil and the leaves and household waste we put on the ground. I will use my own seed pieces from last year's harvest, as everyone does. I will work the plot myself with help from family; the plot is small so I do not need to pay anyone.
